tools.name: unleashed_get_company
tools.description: Fetch the Unleashed company these credentials belong to — name, base currency and default tax rate. A cheap way to confirm the API id, key and signature are right. Unleashed: GET /Companies.

tools.name: unleashed_list_products
tools.description: List products, optionally searched by code/description or filtered by code prefix, group, brand, barcode or modification date. Unleashed: GET /Products/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by Guid — prices, units, stock alert levels, group, brand, supplier. Unleashed: GET /Products/{productGuid}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_stock_on_hand
tools.description: List stock on hand per product — QtyOnHand, AllocatedQty, AvailableQty, OnPurchase, AvgCost — optionally for one warehouse or as at a past date. Unleashed: GET /StockOnHand/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_get_product_stock
tools.description: Stock on hand for one product — totals, or broken down per warehouse with allWarehouses=true. The direct answer to 'how many do we have and where?'. Unleashed: GET /StockOnHand/{productGuid}[/AllWarehouses].

tools.name: unleashed_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally filtered by code or name prefix, currency or modification date. Unleashed: GET /Customers/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by Guid — contact details, addresses, currency, payment terms, credit limit. Unleashed: GET /Customers/{customerGuid}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers, optionally filtered by code prefix, contact email prefix or modification date. Unleashed: GET /Suppliers/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (code, name, default flag, address). Warehouse codes are what other tools filter by. Unleashed: GET /Warehouses/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_product_groups
tools.description: List product groups (name, Guid, parent group) — the category tree products are filed under. Unleashed: GET /ProductGroups/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders, filtered by status, customer, order number, warehouse or date range. Deleted orders are excluded unless asked for. Unleashed: GET /SalesOrders/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_get_sales_order
tools.description: Fetch a single sales order by Guid, with its lines, totals, customer and warehouse. Unleashed: GET /SalesOrders/{orderGuid}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders, filtered by status, supplier, order number, warehouse or date range. Unleashed: GET /PurchaseOrders/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Fetch a single purchase order by Guid, with its lines, supplier and totals. Unleashed: GET /PurchaseOrders/{orderGuid}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, filtered by status, customer, invoice number, sales order number or date range. Unleashed: GET /Invoices/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_sales_quotes
tools.description: List sales quotes, filtered by status, customer, quote number or date range. Unleashed: GET /SalesQuotes/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_stock_adjustments
tools.description: List stock adjustments (write-offs, recounts, corrections) with reason, status and lines, filtered by warehouse, product or date. Unleashed: GET /StockAdjustments/{page}.

tools.name: unleashed_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer. CustomerCode must be unique and cannot be changed later. Unleashed: POST /Customers.

tools.name: unleashed_create_product
tools.description: Create a new product. ProductCode must be unique. Unleashed: POST /Products.

tools.name: unleashed_create_sales_order
tools.description: Create a DRAFT sales order with status Parked (reserves no stock, posts nothing to accounting — a person places or completes it in Unleashed). findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "unleashed_get_company" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: unleashed_list_suppliers · Private data: unleashed_get_company, unleashed_get_customer, unleashed_list_suppliers · Public sink: unleashed_list_suppliers, unleashed_create_customer, unleashed_create_product, unleashed_create_sales_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: unleashed_list_suppliers · Private data: unleashed_get_company, unleashed_get_customer, unleashed_list_suppliers · Public sink: unleashed_list_suppliers, unleashed_create_customer, unleashed_create_product, unleashed_create_sales_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
